nodes.text: Morning mist lifts off the rice terraces of Làng Sương. Drums sound from the đình hall: the river road to the west has gone quiet, and quiet roads are never good news.
Bà Lan, the village elder, waits for you in the plaza. (WASD to walk, E to talk.)

nodes.speaker: elder
nodes.text: Ah, you came. Sit, child. The scouts have not come back from the river road.

nodes.speaker: elder
nodes.text: Something walks out of the jungle at night. It tramples the paddies and it does not stop at fences.

nodes.speaker: elder
nodes.text: Will you hold the west road for us?

nodes.speaker: elder
nodes.text: Our grandmothers called them the hungry ones. Builders of nothing, eaters of everything. They follow the old roads, so towers on the roads will stop them.

nodes.speaker: elder
nodes.text: Wise. Itzel keeps the temple to the east, and Chú Tư's forge is by the road. Come back when you are ready.

nodes.speaker: elder
nodes.text: Are you ready to go west?

nodes.speaker: elder
nodes.text: Then go with the ancestors. I will tell the guard to open the gate. Do not let them reach the village.

nodes.speaker: elder
nodes.text: The gate is open. If you have not seen Itzel and Chú Tư, do so. Their gifts may save you.

nodes.speaker: elder
nodes.text: The drums are playing for you tonight. The river road is ours again, for now.

nodes.speaker: elder
nodes.text: They always do. Rest, then hold the road again when the gate drums call.

nodes.speaker: elder
nodes.text: Then rest. There is rice and fish in the hall, and no one will ask anything of you until morning.

nodes.speaker: elder
nodes.text: They broke through the lower terraces. We lost the harvest there, but no one was hurt. You are alive; that matters more.

nodes.speaker: elder
nodes.text: Go back when you are ready. Talk to Itzel: the temple may lend you more strength.

nodes.speaker: guard
nodes.text: No one goes out this gate without Bà Lan's word. Not with what is on the road.

nodes.speaker: guard
nodes.text: Hold on! The gate stays shut until the elder sends you.

nodes.speaker: guard
nodes.text: Bà Lan sent word. The gate is open: walk west when you are ready. I will keep the lanterns lit for you.

nodes.speaker: priestess
nodes.text: The smoke turned west at dawn. The Feathered Serpent sees what is coming; it always has.

nodes.speaker: priestess
nodes.text: I can ask one favor of the old gods for you. Which do you want?

nodes.speaker: priestess
nodes.text: Then the sky will answer you. Look for the storm towers when you build.

nodes.speaker: priestess
nodes.text: The mist will follow them and drink their strength. They will come at you weaker.

nodes.speaker: priestess
nodes.text: The gods are patient. I am not so patient, but I can wait.

nodes.speaker: priestess
nodes.text: I keep the copal burning for you. Go carefully.

nodes.speaker: priestess
nodes.text: The gods heard you fall. I can ask once more, but it costs: they will not give their mist and their lightning twice to the same hands.
Copal smoke curls up the temple's stepped stones. Carved serpents watch the road from every ledge.

nodes.speaker: smith
nodes.text: Hah! Going to fight them with your bare hands? Let me help, I owe the elder that much.

nodes.speaker: smith
nodes.text: I have fire pots, if you like things burning. Or I give you coin from the forge, and you buy what you need.

nodes.speaker: smith
nodes.text: Good choice. Flame towers will be yours to build. Stand back when they go off.

nodes.speaker: smith
nodes.text: Sixty silver. Spend it on stone and arrows, not on rice wine.

nodes.speaker: smith
nodes.text: Look all you like, the anvil does not bite.

nodes.speaker: smith
nodes.text: The forge stays hot. Bring me back something interesting.

nodes.speaker: smith
nodes.text: You came back in one piece! Here, a little more coin for the next road.

nodes.speaker: child
nodes.text: Are you going out the west gate? Mama says nobody goes out the west gate.

choices.text: Only if Bà Lan says so.

nodes.speaker: child
nodes.text: Bring me back a hungry one's tooth! I will keep it under my mat.

nodes.speaker: child
nodes.text: Bà Lan says so about everything.

nodes.speaker: child
nodes.text: I am practicing with my slingshot. For when they come.

nodes.speaker: child
nodes.text: You did it! You did it! I told everyone you would!

nodes.speaker: child
nodes.text: Are they coming here now? I hid my slingshot under the house, in case.
The gate creaks shut behind you. Lanterns are already being lit along the road, and someone has started the drums.
You limp back through the gate. Smoke rises from the lower terraces, but the village still stands.
